snippet.title: Verbal Beatdown - Official Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming August 28th!

Type words to battle enemy books in this fast-paced spelling game!

Play for FREE on Itch.io now. Coming to Steam August 28th with exclusive character Cthulhu.

Itch.io version: https://robbys.itch.io/verbal-beatdown
Discord: https://discord.gg/myxkdeWj8k
